rosso-corsa.$description: Rosso Corsa — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

rosso-scuro.$description: Rosso Scuro — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

bianco-ferrari.$description: Bianco Ferrari — Canvas, primary text on dark surfaces, iconography, and link color — the dominant tone across the entire interface

carbone-nero.$description: Carbone Nero — Full-bleed dark backgrounds, hero panels, and overlay surfaces — creates the cinematic void behind photography

notte-profonda.$description: Notte Profonda — Footer and secondary dark surfaces — one step softer than pure black to break the infinite void

grafite.$description: Grafite — Borders, dividers, and muted surface treatments — thin structural separation between dark layers

fumo.$description: Fumo — Muted body text, caption labels, and secondary metadata on light surfaces

piombo.$description: Piombo — Supporting body text and quieter label treatments

argento-chiaro.$description: Argento Chiaro — Light surface dividers and disabled borders on white backgrounds

velo-di-luce.$description: Velo di Luce — Lightest surface wash — subtle background tonal shifts on white sections

cemento.$description: Cemento — Section backgrounds on light areas — the only chromatic step in the white canvas

body-font.$description: Body-Font — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

ferrarisans.$description: Primary display and interface typeface — custom sans used across all copy
